chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, when he intended to marry a woman, would send someone to look at her, and he said:
"Smell her neck; if her neck is pleasant, her scent will be pleasant. And if her ankles are fleshy, her body will be well-developed."

key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.كَعْثَبُهَا: her bodily fullness or developed form

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about evaluating a prospective spouse before marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a practice attributed to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله regarding assessing a prospective bride through observable physical traits. It belongs to the chapter on recommended qualities in women and reflects guidance connected to marriage considerations in transmitted prophetic tradition.
